div.div:
Logical awaited RabbitMQ RPC; authenticate/route role guards are abstracted at entry.
Unconditional parallel operand guards are empty; branch names are conveyed by message labels.
Action-driven recommendation exclusions are downstream mobile mutation behavior (mobile:src/hooks/useFriendMutations.ts:136-159), not mandatory steps in every recommendation request.
